description: Caption schema for race portraits. Output by Gemini using Tools/captioning/prompts/portrait_prompt.md.

field_descriptions.anatomy: Body plan, distinctive features (limbs, eyes, skin/scale/fur, head shape).
field_descriptions.coloration: Hue, pattern, contrast across the body.
field_descriptions.attire_and_adornment: Clothing, jewelry, tools, scars, paint, ceremonial markings.
field_descriptions.posture_and_expression: Bearing, gaze, mood, body language conveyed by the pose.
field_descriptions.technology_level_hint: Implied tech level from visible artifacts (clothing weave, accessories, weapons).
field_descriptions.distinctive_traits: Anything unusual or memorable that doesn't fit the other fields.
